text:
In Europe, the **most commonly considered upper-upscale conversion brands** generally fall into two groups: flexible **collection/soft brands** and more standardized **core brands**.

### Frequently shortlisted

| Hotel group | Brands commonly considered | Typical conversion fit |
|---|---|---|
| **Marriott International** | **Autograph Collection**, **Tribute Portfolio** | Leading choices for distinctive independent hotels because much of the existing identity and design can be retained. Marriott reports strong European conversion momentum for both brands. ([marriott-international.pressarea.com](https://marriott-international.pressarea.com/en/pressrelease/details/19580?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Hilton** | **Curio Collection by Hilton** | One of the clearest upper-upscale soft-brand options; particularly suited to historic, boutique, resort and lifestyle properties. Hilton specifically classifies Curio as upper upscale and has expanded it extensively through European conversions. ([stories.hilton.com](https://stories.hilton.com/emea/releases/hilton-expands-rotterdam-portfolio-with-two-new-hotels?utm_source=openai)) |
| **IHG** | **voco**, **Crowne Plaza** | voco is especially conversion-friendly, with flexible property character and relatively adaptable standards; Crowne Plaza is commonly considered for larger business, conference and mixed-demand hotels. IHG’s recent European growth has been heavily conversion-led. ([ihgplc.com](https://www.ihgplc.com/en/news-and-media/news-releases/2025/ihg-hotels-resorts-debuts-9-brands-in-13-countries-across-europe?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Radisson Hotel Group** | **Radisson Blu** | A major conventional upper-upscale conversion candidate, especially for larger city, airport, conference and resort hotels. Radisson describes it as Europe’s largest upper-upscale brand and offers an “easy-to-adopt” design scheme. ([radissonhotels.com](https://www.radissonhotels.com/en-us/corporate/development-opportunities/our-brands?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Accor** | **Mövenpick**, **Pullman**, **MGallery Hotel Collection** | Mövenpick works well for broad premium conversions; Pullman for larger urban and meetings-oriented hotels; MGallery for distinctive boutique, heritage and lifestyle assets. Accor explicitly promotes Mövenpick and its collection brands as conversion-friendly. ([assets.group.accor.com](https://assets.group.accor.com/yrj0orc8tx24/JxyNrWKHVONrsJUk6l4Fc/9aa4b80ff5aae0563c1148657824b8d1/ACCOR_URD2024_UK_20250328_MEL.pdf?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Minor Hotels** | **NH Collection**, sometimes **nhow** or **Tivoli** | Particularly relevant in Spain, Italy, Benelux, Germany and Central Europe. NH Collection is frequently used to reposition existing NH or independent hotels into the premium/upper-upscale tier. ([minorhotels.com](https://www.minorhotels.com/en/development?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Wyndham** | **Dolce Hotels & Resorts by Wyndham** | A specialist upper-upscale option for conference resorts, country estates, golf properties and destination hotels; officially offered for both conversions and new construction. ([development.wyndhamhotels.com](https://development.wyndhamhotels.com/brand/dolce-hotels-resorts-by-wyndham/?utm_source=openai)) |

### Also considered, depending on positioning

- **Vignette Collection by IHG** — for distinctive properties targeting the upper-upscale-to-luxury boundary.
- **The Unbound Collection by Hyatt** — generally appropriate for highly individual, high-end hotels, though often positioned closer to luxury.
- **Radisson Collection** — for landmark assets capable of supporting a higher luxury-oriented renovation.
- **DoubleTree by Hilton** — extremely common for conversions, but normally classified as **upscale rather than strictly upper upscale**. ([stories.hilton.com](https://stories.hilton.com/emea/releases/hilton-expands-rotterdam-portfolio-with-two-new-hotels?utm_source=openai))
- **Tapestry Collection by Hilton** and **Radisson Individuals** — flexible soft brands, but generally positioned in the upscale tier rather than upper upscale. ([stories.hilton.com](https://stories.hilton.com/releases/hilton-to-double-lifestyle-portfolio-in-emea?utm_source=openai))

### Practical first-call shortlist

For a typical European upper-upscale conversion study, the initial brand canvass would usually include:

1. **Autograph Collection**
2. **Tribute Portfolio**
3. **Curio Collection**
4. **voco**
5. **Crowne Plaza**
6. **Radisson Blu**
7. **MGallery**
8. **Mövenpick**
9. **Pullman**
10. **NH Collection**
11. **Dolce by Wyndham**

The best fit depends heavily on room count, existing design, meeting space, location, renovation budget, franchise versus management preference, and whether the owner wants to preserve the hotel’s existing name and identity. Collection brands generally provide the greatest design flexibility, while core brands such as Radisson Blu, Crowne Plaza and Pullman normally require more extensive conformity with brand standards.
